title: Staying Healthy on Safari
excerpt: Sun, dust, water and mosquitoes: practical tips to stay healthy on safari in Tanzania.
body:
- **Drink plenty of water.**
- **Use sunscreen, a hat and sunglasses.**
- **Prevent mosquito bites.** See [malaria](/blog/malaria-tanzania/).
- **Wash hands** before eating.
- **Be careful with food and water.** See [drinking water](/blog/drinking-water-tanzania/).
- **Bring a travel kit:** painkillers, plasters, oral rehydration salts, antihistamines.
- **Bring your own medication**, with copies of prescriptions.
- **Consult a doctor** before departure. See [vaccinations](/blog/tanzania-vaccinations/).

This is general information, not medical advice. [Plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
